authority: architect B1R1 deep-audit rulings; single source of truth for later B2/C0 implementation; any deviation requires architect approval

frozen_requirements.rule: speech_text keeps full punctuation (TTS/script integrity); display_text defaults to NO visible sentence/clause punctuation; protect decimal/version/percent/model/URL internal symbols (no naive 'delete all dots')
hard gate DISPLAY_PUNCTUATION_FORBIDDEN / COUNT / DISPLAY_TEXT_EMPTY_AFTER_NORMALIZE; default acceptance: 0 visible CJK sentence/clause punctuation in display_text except explicit whitelist

clean-no-subtitle material highest priority; bottom stable subtitle band: occlusion plate (region-derived height + margin + high-opacity dark plate) then redraw new caption centered; top/mid large or multi-region dynamic text: REJECT_DIRTY_TEXT (fail-closed, swap candidate); watermark by allowlist else reject; inpaint not first version
SUBTITLE_HYGIENE_NOT_RUN when no source-text detection executed; never pass without detection
explicit 1080x1920 caption coordinates (no reliance on MarginV=75 alone); <=2 lines; line length bounded; caption must not cover product core
after occlusion+redraw sample frames: old subtitle not readable, new caption present, subject not covered; any frame fail -> swap candidate, never warning-only

plan_override runs are SELECTION_ROUTE_BYPASSED and must never be presented as smart-selection success; smart selection requires plan_override=false + source gate + segment identity + BGE/CLIP recorded + beat evidence

when PUBLISH_READY=false deliveries carry NOT_PUBLISHABLE or explicit test purpose; statuses TECHNICAL_AUDIO_TEST_PASS / SUBTITLE_TEST_PASS/FAIL / SELECTION_TEST_NOT_RUN / HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_FAIL / PUBLISH_READY_NO
